finalText:
**Found it.** `computeTotal` in `src/pricing/engine.js` was rounding to cents twice — once after the percent coupon, once after the flat coupon — before converting to the order's currency. That extra rounding threw away fractional cents that mattered once the exchange rate got applied, so GBP, CAD, and JPY carts landed a cent (or yen) short whenever a percent coupon was in play.

It never showed up with a flat coupon alone, which is why it looked random — only percent-discount carts in non-USD currencies were affected.

Fixed by rounding once, only at the very end, after conversion. All 40 tests pass now (`node --test`, ~0.1s).
